ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels concentrated on the medial and lateral lobe surfaces, versus 25% low-intensity black pixels localized to the central notch region, trailing edge margins, and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous white fields on both lobes. A central, low-intensity black bifurcated region extends from the peduncle insertion. Numerous low-intensity linear streaks and small circular spots are distributed across the white high-intensity fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an estimated angle of 55 degrees; the vertex is partially obscured by water turbulence but the lateral walls remain distinct.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-depth variations of 5-20 pixels along the entire trailing boundary, characterized by sharp peaks and shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge, transitioning to a slight convexity as the contour approaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular pixels (barnacle attachment points) are visible along the distal tips and the upper trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) predominantly located on the left lobe, with several long vertical tracks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcification or barnacle accumulation on the extreme lateral tips, creating a highly irregular, jagged perimeter. Several focal dark lesions are visible on the interior white field of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A series of distinct dark, small circular spots concentrated near the leading edge of the left lobe, forming a unique punctate pattern.
